lesson.title: Listening: Fosdyke's story
lesson.title_ar: الاستماع وتكوين الأسئلة: رواية «فوسدايك» المزعومة حول ماري سيلست

lines: 5.8 A Listen to the story of the Mary Celeste as told by a man called 'Fosdyke', and tick the correct boxes.
1 He is speaking in the year 1872. [ ] | He is speaking in the year 1912. [ ]
2 There were 12 people on the ship. [ ] | There were 8 people on the ship. [ ]
3 Most of the sailors were washing the deck. [ ] | All the sailors were washing the deck. [ ]
4 The Captain had his breakfast before the sailors. [ ] | The Captain had his breakfast after the sailors. [ ]
5 The Captain's wife was at the sewing-machine. [ ] | The Captain's daughter was at the sewing-machine. [ ]
6 The platform at the bow of the ship was for Fosdyke. [ ] | The platform of the bow of the ship was for the Captain's daughter. [ ]
7 One of the sailors tried to swim around the ship. [ ] | The Captain tried to swim around the ship. [ ]
8 Everybody climbed onto the platform to watch the sailor. [ ] | Everybody climbed onto the platform to jump into the sea. [ ]
9 The man in the water screamed when another sailor jumped in. [ ] | The man in the water screamed when sharks attacked and killed him. [ ]
(WB p. 65) 10 Everybody fell into the sea when the platform broke. [ ] | everybody jumped off the platform to help the men in the sea. [ ]
11 Fosdyke climbed back on the Mary Celeste. [ ] | The Mary Celeste sailed on with nobody abroad. [ ]
12 Nobody on the small island believe Fosdyke. [ ] | Nobody in England believed Fosdyke. [ ]
B When Fosdyke got back to England, he was asked a lot of questions. Below are some of the answers he gave. Write the questions.
1 Answer: Only myself. I was the only passenger.
2 Answer: He built it at the bow of the ship.
3 Answer: He said: 'I can swim around the ship with my clothes on.'
4 Answer: Yes. He climbed onto the platform with his wife.
5 Answer: Some were attacked by sharks and others drowned.
6 Answer: I held onto a piece of wood and swam there.

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي وتوثيق الشريط الصوتي (RULE 2 & RULE 7):
1) حُفظت الصيغ المطبوعة في 5.8 A حرفياً كما ظهرت في wb-065 وwb-066: platform of the bow (بند 6)، وبدء السطر بحرف صغير everybody jumped (بند 10)، وnobody abroad بدل aboard (بند 11)، وحذف حرف d في believe Fosdyke (بند 12).
2) تكشف إجابات 5.8 B المطبوعة مسبقاً قيماً قطعية (مثل أن فوسدايك نجا بقطعة خشب فترك السفينة تسير خالية، وأن أحداً لم يعترض على هجوم القروش على السابح، وأن المنصة كانت عند المقدمة) غير أن الاختيار الكامل لـ 5.8 A (1–12) مرتبط بنص الكاسيت غير المطبوع في الكتاب؛ لذا سُجّل 5.8 A في REVIEW_NEEDED.md وأُجيزت أسئلة 5.8 B (1–6) 100% من نصوص الإجابات المطبوعة.

abroad.ar: في الخارج (مطبوعة خطأً بدل aboard في A #11)

activities.prompt_literal: 5.8 B When Fosdyke got back to England, he was asked a lot of questions. Below are some of the answers he gave. Write the questions.
activities.prompt_ar: كوّن السؤال المناسب لكل إجابة من إجابات فوسدايك الست في WB ص 65 (محسومة نحوياً ومعنوياً من الإجابات المطبوعة):

items.question: Answer 1: 'Only myself. I was the only passenger.'
items.model_answer: Were there any other passengers on the ship? / How many passengers were on the Mary Celeste?
items.explain_ar: الإجابة تقتصر على فوسدايك بوصفه الراكب الوحيد (the only passenger).

items.question: Answer 2: 'He built it at the bow of the ship.'
items.model_answer: Where did he (the captain/carpenter) build the platform?
items.explain_ar: الإجابة تحدد المكان (at the bow of the ship)، فيبدأ السؤال بـ Where.

items.question: Answer 3: 'He said: "I can swim around the ship with my clothes on."'
items.explain_ar: الإجابة تنقل كلام أحد البحارة (He said...).

items.question: Answer 4: 'Yes. He climbed onto the platform with his wife.'
items.model_answer: Did the Captain climb onto the platform too (with his wife)?
items.explain_ar: تبدأ بـ Yes لذا يكون سؤالاً تقريرياً بـ Did.

items.question: Answer 5: 'Some were attacked by sharks and others drowned.'
items.model_answer: What happened to the other people (in the sea)?
items.explain_ar: توضّح مصير البقية بين القروش والغرق.

items.question: Answer 6: 'I held onto a piece of wood and swam there.'
items.model_answer: How did you reach (get to) the island (land)?
items.explain_ar: تشرح الوسيلة والكيفية (أمسكت بلوح خشب وسبحت إلى هناك)، فيبدأ بـ How.

hints: 1: How many passengers... / Were there... · 2: Where did... · 3: What did... · 4: Did the Captain... · 5: What happened to... · 6: How did you...

activities.prompt_literal: 5.8 A Items deducible cleanly vs items requiring cassette playback (RULE 7):
activities.prompt_ar: ما يُستدل عليه صراحةً من أسئلة التمرين B وما يتطلب تشغيل الشريط الصوتي المفقود في A (1–12):

items.question: Items in 5.8 A echoed explicitly by printed WB 5.8 B + PB p. 37
items.model_answer:
• #7: 'watch the sailor' in #8 & PB 'one of the sailors' + B #3 ('swim around the ship') points to the sailor trying to swim (#7 opt 1) and everyone climbing onto the platform to watch him (#8 opt 1).
• #9 & B #5 ('Some were attacked by sharks'): confirms sharks attacked (#9 opt 2).
• #11 & B #6 ('swam there' + Mary Celeste found empty): confirms the Mary Celeste sailed on with nobody aboard ('abroad' in print) (#11 opt 2).
• #12 & B heading ('When Fosdyke got back to England...'): confirms nobody in England believed Fosdyke (#12 opt 2).
items.explain_ar: استنتاج موثّق فقط بما ورد لفظياً داخل إجابات التمرين B نفسهِ.

items.question: Items 5.8 A (#1, #2, #3, #4, #5, #6, #10) depending strictly on cassette audio
items.model_answer: Exact year Fosdyke spoke (1872 vs 1912), exact crew count (12 vs 8), most vs all washing deck, captain breakfast timing, wife vs daughter at sewing-machine (PB p. 37 only said a child's dress!), who the platform was for, and whether the platform broke (#10) require hearing the Teacher's Book audio and are logged in REVIEW_NEEDED.md.
items.explain_ar: لا نخمّن تفاصيل القصة المختلقة في الكاسيت مثل سنة 1912 أو عدد الطاقم 8/12 دون الشريط الرسمي.

hints: التاريخ الواقعي لـ 'قصة فوسدايك' في الأدبيات قد يختلف عن تفاصيل شريط المنهج المعدّل؛ لذا نلتزم بقاعدة عدم التخمين.

questions.stem: In WB 5.8 B, which question produces Fosdyke's answer: 'He built it at the bow of the ship.'?

options.text: Where did he build the platform?

options.why_wrong: الإجابة تركز على المكان (at the bow)، لا على اسم الشخص.

options.text: When did he build the platform?
options.why_wrong: الإجابة لم تذكر وقتاً، بل مكاناً.

options.text: Why did he build the platform?
options.why_wrong: لم تذكر الإجابة سبباً، إنما ذكرت موضع البناء عند مقدّمة السفينة.

hints: العبارة at the bow of the ship تدل على المكان ← Where.
questions.explain: السؤال عن المكان في الزمن الماضي يكون بـ Where + did + الفاعل + المصدر.

questions.stem: In WB 5.8 B, why must Question #4 begin with an auxiliary verb ('Did...') instead of a Wh-word?

options.text: Because the given answer starts with 'Yes.' ('Yes. He climbed onto the platform with his wife.')
Because the sentence uses Present continuous.
options.why_wrong: الفعل في الإجابة climbed ماضٍ بسيط (Past simple).

options.text: Because it asks for a place.
options.why_wrong: لو سألت عن المكان لما بدأت الإجابة بـ Yes.

hints: انظر الكلمة الأولى في الإجابة رقم 4 في WB ص 65.
questions.explain: البدء بـ Yes أو No في الجواب يوجب تكوين سؤال هل (Yes/No question) يبدأ بالفعل المساعد الموافق للزمن الماضي (Did).

flashcards.front: Answer starts with 'Yes.' in Past simple → ?
flashcards.back: Did + subject + infinitive (مثل: Did he climb...?)
abroad: خارج البلد | aboard: على متن سفينة/طائرة (طُبعت سهواً abroad في 5.6 B و5.8 A)

extraction_audit.wb_ocr_vs_image: طُوبقت صفحتا WB ص 64–65 مع wb-065.png وwb-066.png: صُحّحت أخطاء OCR في الأرقام والسطور ('sewine-machine' ← 'sewing-machine', '12 Nobody') وحُفظت الصيغ المطبوعة حرفياً في #6 ('of the bow') و#10 ('everybody') و#11 ('nobody abroad') و#12 ('believe').
